scenario: the real 2013 Target Corporation data breach
notes: Not synthetic - built from the public record. Stolen third-party vendor (Fazio Mechanical) credentials, POS malware, FTP exfiltration. Sources: U.S. Senate Commerce Committee 'Kill Chain' analysis, March 2014 (commerce.senate.gov), and Target/DOJ public statements from December 2013-January 2014. Event dates are real and reported; exact time-of-day and internal IPs/hostnames were never made public, so those fields are placeholders.

scenario: the real Levandowski / Waymo trade-secret case
notes: Not synthetic. A Google/Waymo engineer downloaded 14,000+ confidential self-driving car design files before resigning to start a competitor that Uber later acquired. Sources: Waymo's public complaint (waymo.com/blog, February 2017) for the download details, and the U.S. Department of Justice's press release on the criminal indictment (justice.gov, August 2019) for the January 27, 2016 resignation date. The mid-December 2015 download date is this project's own estimate from combining those two sources ('about six weeks before' the confirmed resignation date), not a separately published exact date.
